project.description: A two-storey starter: a side-hall plan with the living room, dining room, kitchen and family room downstairs, a mudroom and powder room by the back door, and an L-shaped stair to three bedrooms upstairs - the primary suite under a vaulted ceiling - with a hall bath and an upstairs laundry, under one gable roof. A Floorspec 0.3 starter template; every wall, door and window type is the US starter library's.
project.name: Two-storey house
